summary: Classic pivots formed a stable distance/reach ladder, but exact pivot coordinates did not show a reliable incremental magnet, stall, trend-terminal or reversal mechanism versus nearby placebo coordinates. Pivots were retained only as a descriptive range/distance map.
robustness: 5,000 pair-year-week clustered bootstrap; Holm correction across 20 primaries; pair breadth and leave-one-pair-out stability reported.
Independent assurance recomputed exact primary points and used a separately seeded bootstrap.
limitations: High absolute reach rates do not prove magnetism because opportunity/distance and nearby deterministic controls explain the apparent effect.
The result rejects the preregistered broad exact-coordinate mechanisms; it does not claim that pivots have no descriptive value.
authorized_next: Use pivots descriptively as a probabilistic range/distance map.
A separately preregistered spatial-zone question may be tested without rewriting this failed exact-coordinate result.
prohibited_next: No formula shopping, pair/session/year rescue, P&L optimization, Pine implementation or protected-holdout opening for the rejected broad mechanism.

assurance.decision: Independent assurance PASS; exact primary points and independently seeded bootstrap reproduced.
